27021-an-explorer-s-adventures-in-tibet.title: An Explorer'S Adventures In Tibet
27021-an-explorer-s-adventures-in-tibet.creator: A. Henry Savage Landor
27021-an-explorer-s-adventures-in-tibet.description: A book by A. Henry Savage Landor. This strange country, cold and barren, lies on a high tableland in the heart of Asia. The average height of this desolate tableland--some 15,000 feet above sea-level--is higher than the highest mountains of Europe. People are right when they call it the "roof of the world." Nothing, or next to nothing, grows on that high plateau, except poor shrubs and grass in the lower valleys.

65365-the-story-of-a-needle.title: The Story Of A Needle
65365-the-story-of-a-needle.creator: Unknown

I can just fancy how the water fizzed and hissed, and how my fiery flush faded suddenly away, and I became again quite black in the face!

73048-towards-an-enduring-peace.title: Towards An Enduring Peace
73048-towards-an-enduring-peace.creator: Unknown
73048-towards-an-enduring-peace.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Jane Addams has been head resident at Hull House in Chicago for many years. She is widely known for her leadership in the social movement, and particularly for her connection with the International Congress of Women at The Hague.

arxiv-2101-10121.title: Game-Theoretic and Machine Learning-based Approaches for Defensive Deception: A Survey
arxiv-2101-10121.creator: Mu Zhu, Ahmed H. Anwar, Zelin Wan, Jin-Hee Cho, Charles Kamhoua, Munindar P. Singh
arxiv-2101-10121.description: Abstract Defensive deception is a promising approach for cyber defense. Via defensive deception, the defender can anticipate attacker actions; it can mislead or lure attacker, or hide real resources. Although defensive deception is increasingly popular in the research community, there has not been a systematic investigation of its key components, the underlying principles, and its tradeoffs in various problem settings.

arxiv-2103-08225.title: Liquid-liquid phase separation, biomolecular condensates, puncta, non-stoichiometric supramolecular assemblies, membraneless organelles, and bacterial chemotaxis are best understood as emergent phenomena with switch-like behaviour
arxiv-2103-08225.creator: Richard P Sear
arxiv-2103-08225.description: Abstract Liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) is currently of great interest in cell biology. LLPS is an example of what is called an emergent phenomenon – an idea that comes from condensed-matter physics. Emergent phenomena have the characteristic feature of having a switch-like response.

arxiv-2109-12453.title: Classification of COVID-19 from CXR Images in a 15-class Scenario: an Attempt to Avoid Bias in the System
arxiv-2109-12453.creator: Chinmoy Bose, Anirvan Basu
arxiv-2109-12453.description: Abstract As of June 2021, the World Health Organization (WHO) has reported 171.7 million confirmed cases including 3,698,621 deaths from COVID-19. Detecting COVID-19 and other lung diseases from Chest X-Ray (CXR) images can be very effective for emergency diagnosis and treatment as CXR is fast and cheap.

arxiv-2207-04455.title: The Price of Stability for First Price Auction
arxiv-2207-04455.creator: Yaonan Jin, Pinyan Lu
arxiv-2207-04455.description: Abstract This paper establishes the Price of Stability ( PoS ) for First Price Auctions , for all equilibrium concepts that have been studied in the literature: Bayesian Nash Equilibrium ⊊ \subsetneq Bayesian Correlated Equilibrium ⊊ \subsetneq Bayesian Coarse Correlated Equilibrium .

arxiv-2208-11498.title: Slow-rotating black holes with potential in dynamical Chern-Simons modified gravitational theory
arxiv-2208-11498.creator: G. G. L. Nashed 1, Shin’ichi Nojiri 2,3
arxiv-2208-11498.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by G. G. L. Nashed 1, Shin’ichi Nojiri 2,3. The Chern-Simons amended gravity theory appears as a low-energy effective theory of string theory. The effective theory includes an anomaly-cancelation correction to the Einstein-Hilbert action. The Chern-Simons expression consists of the product φ ​ R ​ R ~ \varphi R\tilde{R} of the Pontryagin density R ​ R ~ R\tilde{R} with a scalar field φ \varphi , where the latter is considered a background field (dynamical construction or non-dynamical construction).

arxiv-2308-07557.title: Character-Oriented Design for Visual Data Storytelling
arxiv-2308-07557.creator: \authororcid Keshav Dasu0000-0002-7689-4368, \authororcid Yun-Hsin Kuo0009-0000-1891-8993, and \authororcid Kwan-Liu Ma0000-0001-8086-0366
arxiv-2308-07557.description: Abstract When telling a data story, an author has an intention they seek to convey to an audience. This intention can be of many forms such as to persuade, to educate, to inform, or even to entertain. In addition to expressing their intention, the story plot must balance being consumable and enjoyable while preserving scientific integrity.

arxiv-2502-08703.title: The Mechanism behind the Information Encoding for Islands
arxiv-2502-08703.creator: Hao Geng
arxiv-2502-08703.description: Abstract Entanglement islands are subregions in a gravitational universe whose information is fully encoded in a disconnected non-gravitational system away from it. In the context of the black hole information paradox, entanglement islands state that the information about the black hole interior is encoded in the early-time Hawking radiation.

arxiv-2503-20911.title: From SIMP miracles to WIMP dead ends: navigating the freeze out of MeV-mass dark matter
arxiv-2503-20911.description: Abstract We summarize here our studies [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] on two distinct scenarios for MeV-mass thermal dark matter freeze-out. First, we determine the minimal viable mass for dark matter below tens of MeV, considering annihilation into Standard Model particles, including photons, electrons, and neutrinos.

pmc-10628083.title: Early detection of a possible multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii outbreak in the local hospital setting by using random amplified polymorphism DNA-polymerase chain reaction (RAPD-PCR), oxacillinase gene profiles, and antibiograms
pmc-10628083.creator: Ni Nengah Dwi Fatmawati, Gede Ngurah Rsi Suwardana, Ida Ayu Gde Wahyudevi Dharmika, Ni Made Adi Tarini, I Nengah Sujaya, I Wayan Suranadi
pmc-10628083.description: Background and Objectives:Detecting the source of a potential outbreak of multidrug resistant (MDR) Acinetobacter baumannii is necessary to be investigated. This study aimed to detect the possibility of A. baumannii outbreak in a hospital setting using a combination of random amplified polymorphism DNA-polymerase chain reaction (RAPD-PCR), antibiograms, and the presence of oxacillinase genes.

pmc-11354110.title: Critical Factors Affecting Outcomes of Endodontic Microsurgery: A Retrospective Japanese Study
pmc-11354110.creator: Masashi Yamada, Norio Kasahara, Satoru Matsunaga, Rie Fujii, Norihito Miyayoshi, Sayo Sekiya, Isabel Ding, Christopher A McCulloch, Rafał Obuchowicz, Małgorzata Pihut, Karolina Nurzynska, Andrzej Urbanik
pmc-11354110.description: The critically important preoperative and intraoperative factors that affect the success of endodontic microsurgery (EMS) in Japanese patients are not defined. We conducted a retrospective study that analyzed treatment outcomes for 46 teeth in 46 Japanese patients. Treatment was provided between March 2013 and March 2015.

pmc-11431666.title: Heterogating Gel Iontronics: A Revolution in Biointerfaces and Ion Signal Transmission
pmc-11431666.creator: Zhixin Wu, Ziguang Zhao, Dirk Kuckling
pmc-11431666.description: Currently, existing iontronic systems are limited and struggle to process electronic-to-multi-ionic transport, resulting in interchange inefficiencies and incompatibilities between artificial ion devices and biological tissue interfaces. The development of heterogating gel iontronics offers a significant advancement in bridging this gap, drawing inspiration from the complex ionic transmission mechanisms found in biological synapses within neural networks.

pmc-11492751.title: Type 2 diabetes and susceptibility to COVID-19: a machine learning analysis
pmc-11492751.creator: Motahare Shabestari, Reyhaneh Azizi, Akram Ghadiri-Anari
pmc-11492751.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) was one of the most prevalent comorbidities among patients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). Interactions between different metabolic parameters contribute to the susceptibility to the virus; thereby, this study aimed to rank the importance of clinical and laboratory variables as risk factors for COVID-19 or as protective factors against it by applying machine learning methods.

pmc-11546155.title: Portfolio practices in the principal evaluation process: A qualitative case study
pmc-11546155.creator: Ahmed Mohammed Alkaabi, Asma Khaleel Abdallah
pmc-11546155.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe portfolio is a vital component of the evaluation of principals and serves as a repository of evidence of achievements, skills, and capabilities. It facilitates the meticulous recording and documentation of experiences undertaken.

pmc-12546884.title: Weight loss remains a challenge for idiopathic intracranial hypertension patients: A retrospective case series from Kenya
pmc-12546884.creator: Zian Muikamba, Jaskirat Sokhi, Jasmit Shah, Sheila Marco, Juzar Hooker, Dilraj Sokhi
pmc-12546884.description: BackgroundIdiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) is a neurological condition characterized by elevated intracranial CSF pressure without demonstratable evident causes. The mechanisms leading to a particular predilection for women of childbearing age who are overweight and obese or who have recent rapid weight changes remain imprecisely described. If undiagnosed, it can progress to disabling irreversible visual loss.

pmc-13260619.title: Integrative multi-omics reveals genetic and transcriptomic determinants of aroma formation during alcoholic fermentation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
pmc-13260619.creator: Inseo Kim, Sung Han Kim, Soo Kweon Lee, Eunkyung Choi, Soyun Choi, Doyoon Shin, Ahyoung Lim, Seokmin Yoon, Hyun Park
pmc-13260619.description: Aroma-active volatile organic compounds (VOCs) produced during alcoholic fermentation by Saccharomyces cerevisiae are key determinants of the sensory quality of fermented beverages. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying strain-specific aroma diversity remain incompletely understood. Thus, this study aimed to integrate genomic, transcriptomic, and metabolomic analyses to elucidate the genetic and regulatory determinants of VOC biosynthesis in three S. cerevisiae strains.
